rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in veterinary medicine regardless of delivery method (online and asynchronous accepted); CE used for another state's renewal may count
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after initial licensure.
rules.alternatives: Requirement met by active enrollment in an AVMA COE-accredited DVM program or an AVMA ABVS-recognized residency/fellowship; hardship waiver under IC 25-1-4-4.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation 3 years after the renewal period; CE made up after an audit cannot be reused.
rules.notes: Renewal October 15 of odd years (next Oct 15, 2027). Presenters: presentation time plus up to 2 h prep per hour; up to 5 h for writing peer-reviewed articles or books.
